groundability.evidence: Unused annual leave of up to 10 days may be carried forward into the next leave year. Any balance above 10 days lapses on 31 December.
Employees receive 6 days of casual leave per leave year.
Office hours are 9:30 am to 6:00 pm, Monday to Friday, with a 45 minute lunch break.
Attendance is recorded through the biometric system. Arriving after 10:00 am is recorded as a late mark. Three late marks in a calendar month are treated as half a day of casual leave.

Business casual dress is expected in the office. Employees visiting a vessel, shipyard or terminal must wear safety shoes, a helmet and a high visibility vest, and must complete the site safety induction before boarding.
Expense claims must be submitted in the HRMS portal within 30 days of completing the trip.
A daily allowance covers meals and incidental expenses. It is INR 1,200 per day for G1 and G2 and INR 1,800 per day for G3 and above.
groundability.method: llm + quote verification; downgraded: topic keywords barely present

groundability.evidence: Employees with a work related grievance should follow these levels in order. Level 1: raise the grievance with the reporting manager, who must respond within 5 working days. Level 2: if unresolved, escalate in writing to the Head of Department, who must respond within 7 working days. Level 3: if still unresolved, elevate to the Grievance Committee chaired by the Head of HR, which gives a final decision within 15 working days.

conflicts.about: Maximum value of retainable gifts from clients/agents
conflicts.quote_a: Employees may accept gifts or hospitality from suppliers, agents or clients only if the value is below INR 2,000 per occasion.
conflicts.quote_b: Gifts received from clients or agents during an official trip may be retained if their value does not exceed INR 5,000.
conflicts.reason: Both passages define the threshold for retaining gifts from clients or agents, but they provide different monetary limits (INR 2,000 vs INR 5,000) without Passage A explicitly acknowledging the travel exception found in Passage B. (second model openai/gpt-oss-20b disagreed)
